citation: State of Maharashtra v. Rajesh Sharma (2019) 4 SCC 123
reasoning_summary: Mens rea established through eyewitness testimony regarding prior threats and angry altercation. Chain of custody confirmed through fingerprints on weapon and bloodstains matching victim. IPC 302 applied as intention to kill was proven beyond reasonable doubt.

facts_established.mens_rea: Prior argument and threats witnessed by neighbor
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Fingerprints on knife, accused arrested at scene
